facts.fact: Agence Ecofin reports that SOGEB, the national backbone operator, announced on 20 May 2026 that the first loop of Guinea's national fibre-optic backbone was raised from 200 to 400 Gb/s with Huawei's technical support, after a 50 to 200 Gb/s step in December 2024; SOGEB says it improves interurban communications; the article gives no towns or km.
